name: Asakura Sayumi
source: The younger step sister of the protagonist. They both go to the same school but she is not very academically minded. Her father remarried the protagonist's mother but he spends a lot of time overseas so for the time being is staying with them.
translation: 主人公年幼的继妹。两人就读同一所学校，但她不太擅长学习。她的父亲与主人公的母亲再婚，却长期在海外，因此她暂时和他们一起生活。
